task_description: Read a certificate file for a host name.
Download a report from the reports folder.
Reset a settings file by profile name (default, compact, wide).
Remove a draft file belonging to a user.
Read a theme stylesheet by theme name.
Delete an old export by its file name.
Format a list of file names as an HTML list.
Rotate the log of a service chosen by name (web, worker, scheduler).
Delete a temporary file created for a job.
Return a thumbnail image by its path.
